pure-canvas.$description: Pure Canvas — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Elevated surface tier, input backgrounds, subtle section panels

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, borders, dark button fills — the typographic and structural black

graphite.$description: Graphite — Headline text alternative — slightly softened black for display type where pure black feels too clinical

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, structural separators

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Subtle borders on less prominent elements

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Primary action button fill, selected nav indicator, link accents — the only saturated action color in the system

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Brand violet for headings, link underlines, decorative accent — anchors the identity when blue is too functional

indigo-pulse.$description: Indigo Pulse — Gradient endpoint, section heading accent — lighter companion to Deep Violet for layered brand moments

lime-highlight.$description: Lime Highlight — Surface wash, background tints, decorative highlight zones — injects energy into otherwise monochrome sections

lemon-note.$description: Lemon Note — Subtle highlight wash on text and borders, callout markers — warm counterpoint to cool brand colors

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft section background gradient start, card shadow tint — atmospheric color for gradient washes

input-blue.$description: Input Blue — Input border on focus/active state — cool desaturated blue for form interactivity

arial.$description: System fallback for icon labels, micro-UI tags, and utility text at 10–13px. Functions as the safety net for extremely small UI where custom fonts may not load.

madefor-display.$description: All display headlines from 21px sub-headings up to 184px hero text. Geometric, slightly condensed sans-serif with wide apertures. The negative letter-spacing (-0.01em to -0.03em) tightens as size grows, creating a distinctive compressed display look at 82–184px. Substantial line-height range (0.85 at 184px) lets oversized type sit close together — a signature of editorial display use.

madefor-text.$description: Body text, nav links, list items, input fields, descriptions. Slightly looser than display at -0.01em. Generous line-heights (1.5–1.71) give body copy an airy, readable cadence. Pairs with display variant to create typographic contrast without switching families.

madefor-text-mediumbold.$description: Semi-emphasis body and small headings (12–24px). Functions as the medium weight for nav, subheadings, and labeled sections where extra weight is needed without going to a full bold.

wix-madefor-display-v2.$description: Alternate display variant for section headings at 53px and body emphasis at 20–21px. Provides a slightly different geometry for variety within sections.

wix-madefor-text-v2.$description: Secondary text body for links and supporting copy where the primary text variant is too dense.

madefor-text-bold.$description: madefor-text-bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
